newsitem.title: UK: Sonatrach seeks big gas oil price rise in October.
newsitem.headline: Sonatrach seeks big gas oil price rise in October.

text.p: State Algerian oil company Sonatrach wants to raise gas oil prices by $2 to $3 per tonne in October, contract holders said on Friday.
They said Sonatrach was looking for a premium of $3 to $4 over the formula for low sulphur gas oil cargoes to be delivered in October, against the $1 premium it asked in September.
"Sonatrach is aiming for a premium of $3 but I think this is rather high. I was prepared to live with a 50 cents rise over September but this is excessive," one contract holder said.
"We were pretty surprised when we were told our premium suggestions should be between $3 to $4," said another.
Monthly negotiations over the premium are currently in full swing and Sonatrach is expected to name its price next Monday or Tuesday.
"They argue because most the cargoes will go into Mediterranean the premium should reflect the fact the Med is stronger," said another contract holder. "I think it should be closer to $2."
Sonatrach is expected to deliver about eight low sulphur contract cargoes in October. -- Melanie Goodfellow, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714
